title: genista anglica subsp. ancistrocarpa
intro: Genista anglica subsp. ancistrocarpa, commonly known as English broom, is a plant species that belongs to the legume family and is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Genista anglica subsp. ancistrocarpa include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and exhibit antiparasitic and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
